Chapter 917: Chapter 17: Lin Yuan and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss (Please Subscribe)

After Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the space-time domain entered the Seventh Realm, as long as he was within the range of space-time he could sense, he could materialize an incarnation at any location.

The Sixth Realm of space-time allowed Lin Yuan’s thoughts to travel instantaneously.

Here, ‘instantaneously’ still requires time.

Albeit exceedingly brief.

But the Seventh Realm of space-time allows Lin Yuan to descend synchronously.

There is no doubt that this is much stronger than the Sixth Realm of space-time, which requires crossing an actual distance.

There may be obstructions along the way, such as certain perilous space-time terrains that cannot be crossed by space-time travel.

In contrast, the Seventh Realm of space-time is different; no matter how many perilous labyrinths separate the locations, as long as they are still within the range of space-time Lin Yuan can sense, he can descend directly.

The range of space-time Lin Yuan can now sense is roughly equivalent to the size of dozens of Immortal Realms.

The Immortal Realm is vast and boundless, equivalent to one percent of the Main Universe’s territory; dozens of Immortal Realms… that’s already equivalent to a good part of the Main Universe.

In other words, if he returns to the Main Universe, Lin Yuan can appear at any place within most of the territories of the Main Universe with just a thought.

Even if using the two Primordial Spirits as ‘reference points’, sitting in key nodes of the Main Universe, he could appear instantaneously within all locations of the Main Universe.

The only downside is that the one descending is merely an incarnation.

But with Lin Yuan’s current level of rule comprehension and strength of spirit and will, even if it’s just an incarnation, the battle power exhibited can far surpass the Emperor of Demonic Beings.

And when necessary, the true self, the original being, can descend using the ‘incarnation’ as coordinates.

…

Just now, Lin Yuan was guiding the numerous Martial Tao cultivators of the Spirit Realm through the Space-Time Passage, leading them to the Immortal Realm, when he perceived the Master of the Abyss’s scrutiny.

Therefore, he simply came to meet face-to-face with the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

Actually, even without the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s scrutiny, Lin Yuan also intended to meet this ruler of the Demon Abyss, an existence of the Twelfth Layer.

…

“Ancestor of Martial Arts?”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss looked solemn; he observed Lin Yuan carefully, realizing that the person before him seemed not to be in this space-time, but talking to him was merely an image, a projection.

“I have never heard of you,” the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss said with a tone of confusion.

Although he spent most of his time in slumber, given Lin Yuan’s strength, he must have left traces in the distant past.

But in reality, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss had never heard the name Ancestor of Martial Arts.

“It doesn’t matter if you have not heard of it now, just remember it in the future,” Lin Yuan said.

Actually, for the past several centuries, under the promotion of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, the Martial Tao has also been spreading.

But the noise was too faint, and most forces in the Xuantian Immortal Domain hadn’t even heard of it.

Let alone the exalted Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

Hearing this, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss fell silent for a moment, then asked, “I wonder what the Ancestor of Martial Arts is here for?”

“Indeed, there are two matters,” Lin Yuan nodded as he spoke.

This was also the main purpose of his descent to meet the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

“Please speak,” the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss looked at Lin Yuan.

At his level, no one has ever dared to make demands of him.

But the mastery of space-time revealed by Lin Yuan placed great pressure on the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

“Since I am the Ancestor of Martial Arts, I naturally follow the path of the Martial Tao and have trained a few disciples who will walk in the Immortal Realm in the future,” Lin Yuan sighed, “I hope the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss would not strike at my weak disciples, nor take the initiative to suppress and destroy the Martial Tao Cultivation System.”

For the Martial Tao Cultivation System to last in the Immortal Realm, besides the need for foundational dissemination, even more critical is the attitude of a Twelfth Layer existence like the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

If the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss despises the Martial Tao Cultivation System, even if one day it spreads throughout the thirty-three domains of the Immortal Realm, it would still be condemned to destruction.

Naturally, this is under the premise that Lin Yuan does not intervene.

“Martial Tao Cultivation System…”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss had a deep gaze, pondering for a long time before saying, “I will not make a move.”

With his status and strength, even if Lin Yuan didn’t say so, he wouldn’t deign to strike at the weak.

In the past, all the battles between immortals and demons were caused by the creatures the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss casually created; as for the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss himself, he had never taken action.

“The other matter…” Lin Yuan smiled slightly and continued, “I have heard that the Origin of the Immortal Realm contains the realm’s most fundamental rules manifest, so I plan to visit the Origin of the Immortal Realm.”

As soon as these words came out.

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss narrowed his eyes.

“I don’t understand the meaning of the Ancestor of Martial Arts, the Origin of the Immortal Realm is not the Demon Abyss.”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s message was clear: the Origin of the Immortal Realm belongs to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, Lin Yuan should inquire with the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

“Hahaha…” Lin Yuan laughed and said, “All the immortals in the Immortal Realm, as well as the demonic beings from the Demon Abyss, believe that the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss are opposed, and the wars between immortals and demons stem from that.”

“But shouldn’t the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss share the same consciousness? Asking you would be no different from asking the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, right?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

It must be said that there are significant differences between the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss and the Ancestor of the Immortal Path; even among the Twelve Layer ultimates in the Main Universe, not everyone could discern that the two are essentially one.

Lin Yuan was also only able to determine this after his comprehension of space-time reached the Seventh Realm, through the subtle hints within the space-time domain, and the space-time structure of the Immortal Realm and the Demon Abyss; that the so-called Immortal Realm has, from the beginning to end, only one ultimate existence.

As for the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, they are simply two sides of the same coin.

“You actually saw through it,” the face of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss showed no expression.

Now that Lin Yuan had made it so clear, there was no need for him to continue the pretense.
